content: ExAws.S3 works against Cloudflare R2 by overriding config: region set to 'auto' (or 'us-east-1' per some examples), host/url set to https://<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, using an R2 API token's access_key_id/secret_access_key. Server-side ExAws.S3.put_object/3 |> ExAws.request/1 works directly for a mix-task upload (not the presigned-URL browser-upload flow, which is a separate concern only needed for direct client uploads).
